# Performance consideration: GPU allocation not specified in batch script. Job may not have access to GPUs.
# Note: Flux uses {{name}}, {{userid}}, and {{id}} for job name, user, and job ID substitution instead of %x, %u, and %j.

python task_b.py \
    --loss "triplet"  \
    --miner "BatchHard" \
	--output_path "outputs_task_c/" \
    --dataset "mit_split" \

    --dataset_path "/home/mcv/datasets/MIT_split/" \
	--model resnet_18 \
    --embedding_size 256 \
	--batch_size 64 \
    --epochs 20

### REQUIREMENTS & CONSTRAINTS
You MUST not make up directives that do not exist.
You MUST preserve as many options as possible from the original.
